Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 0
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misclassified the relationships by assuming that “food” being nonliving makes option D a living–nonliving interaction, when the described relationship is actually between two living organisms (flower and butterfly). The Planner overlooked option C, which correctly represents a living–nonliving interaction (a tree removing a gas from the air). The error was compounded by a premature TASK_COMPLETE decision without systematically evaluating each option against the criteria.
